company.shortDescription: Current is a consumer fintech banking platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans.
company.description:
Current is a leading consumer fintech banking platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans. We're focused on building integrated solutions to solve needs that stand between Americans and their financial goals, making it easier for everyone to build the future they deserve. To learn more about us, visit http://www.current.com or download our app on the App Store or Google Play.

Current is backed by investments from Andreessen Horowitz, Tiger Global Management, Avenir, Wellington Management, General Catalyst, Cross River, Foundation Capital and QED Investors.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile spending account with a Visa debit card for direct deposits, purchases, ATM access, cash deposits, peer-to-peer transfers, budgeting, and spending insights.
productsAndServices.name: Current Account and Visa Debit Card

productsAndServices.description: A secured charge card that helps users establish or improve credit history through everyday spending and monthly payments, without a credit check or annual fee.

productsAndServices.description: Goal-based savings spaces within Current that let users organize funds, automate saving, and receive variable bonus rates on eligible balances.

productsAndServices.description: An optional account feature that allows eligible Current customers to complete certain transactions beyond their available balance without an overdraft fee.
productsAndServices.name: Fee-Free Overdraft

productsAndServices.description: An in-app cryptocurrency trading service that lets users buy and sell dozens of digital assets using funds from their Current spending balance without an additional trading fee.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $80,000,000, or 11.72% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $74,820,551 to $1,500,000,000, a 20.05x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
